title: Notch system HUD
brief: Animated notch feedback for native system controls (volume, mute, display brightness, keyboard backlight) on a MacBook with a physical notch, replacing the stock macOS HUD while keeping the camera area empty and the compact music row stationary

artboards.title: Wings
artboards.tradeoff: Never covers the window below; small level bar with no label or device name

artboards.title: Drop-down HUD
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the native HUD, with device name and 16 segments; briefly covers the top of the window

artboards.title: Glow lip
artboards.tradeoff: Zero layout shift while music plays; level is less precise and colored light feels less native
